mapper.sql: CASE WHEN v.published_parse_id IS NOT NULL OR (v.file_revision = 0 AND v.legacy_status = 'PUBLISHED') THEN 'PUBLISHED' WHEN v.latest_parse_id IS NOT NULL OR (v.file_revision = 0 AND v.legacy_status = 'READY') THEN 'READY' WHEN fj.paper_id IS NOT NULL OR (v.file_revision = 0 AND v.legacy_status = 'FAILED') THEN 'FAILED' WHEN (v.file_revision = 0 AND v.legacy_status = 'UNSUPPORTED') OR v.original_type <> 'PDF' THEN 'UNSUPPORTED' ELSE 'UNPROCESSED' END

p.source_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS total_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.archived) AS archived_papers, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'READY') AS ready_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'UNPROCESSED') AS unprocessed_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'UNSUPPORTED') AS unsupported_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched_count, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.claim_count > 0 AND COALESCE(p.run_status, '') NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING', 'PENDING_REVIEW') ) AS causal_extracted_count, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.claim_count = 0 AND p.run_status = 'SUCCEEDED' ) AS causal_no_causal_count, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.run_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' ) AS causal_pending_review_count, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.run_status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING') ) AS causal_extracting_count, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.claim_count = 0 AND p.run_status = 'FAILED' ) AS causal_failed_count, count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT p.archived AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p.matched_work_id) <> '' AND p.claim_count = 0 AND COALESCE(p.run_status, '') NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'FAILED', 'SUCCEEDED') ) AS causal_not_extracted_count, COALESCE(SUM(p.claim_count) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived), 0)::bigint AS causal_claim_count, MIN(p.year) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS year_min, MAX(p.year) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS year_max, MAX(p.updated_at) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) AS latest_updated_at
mapper.select:
WITH failed_jobs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT paper_id, file_revision FROM v2_job_item WHERE state = 'FAILED' AND kind IN ('PARSE', 'PUBLISH') ), claimed_works AS (
SELECT paper_id AS work_id, count(*)::bigint AS claim_count FROM paper_claim_table GROUP BY paper_id
SELECT work_id, claim_count FROM unnest( #{claims.workIds, typeHandler=com.paperflow.adapters.persistence.PgVarcharArrayTypeHandler}, #{claims.counts, typeHandler=com.paperflow.adapters.persistence.PgBigintArrayTypeHandler} ) AS cw(work_id, claim_count)
), latest_runs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (paper_id) paper_id, status FROM v2_causal_run ORDER BY paper_id, updated_at DESC ), papers AS ( SELECT v.source_id, v.publication_year AS year, (v.archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS archived, v.matched_work_id, v.updated_at, AS status, COALESCE(cw.claim_count, 0) AS claim_count, lr.status AS run_status FROM v2_paper v LEFT JOIN failed_jobs fj ON fj.paper_id = v.paper_id AND fj.file_revision = v.file_revision LEFT JOIN claimed_works cw ON v.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND cw.work_id = v.matched_work_id LEFT JOIN latest_runs lr ON lr.paper_id = v.paper_id WHERE v.source_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(v.source_id) <> '' ), grouped AS ( SELECT FROM papers p GROUP BY p.source_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.archived) > 0 ) SELECT g.source_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(os.display_name), ''), g.source_id) AS name, g.total_papers, g.archived_papers, g.published_count, g.ready_count, g.unprocessed_count, g.failed_count, g.unsupported_count, g.matched_count, g.causal_extracted_count, g.causal_no_causal_count, g.causal_pending_review_count, g.causal_extracting_count, g.causal_failed_count, g.causal_not_extracted_count, g.causal_claim_count, g.year_min, g.year_max, g.latest_updated_at FROM grouped g LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = g.source_id

WITH target_papers AS ( SELECT v.paper_id, v.source_id, v.publication_year, v.archived_at, v.matched_work_id, v.published_parse_id, v.latest_parse_id, v.file_revision, v.legacy_status, v.original_type, v.updated_at FROM v2_paper v WHERE v.source_id = #{sourceId} ), failed_jobs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT j.paper_id, j.file_revision FROM v2_job_item j JOIN target_papers tp ON tp.paper_id = j.paper_id AND tp.file_revision = j.file_revision WHERE j.state = 'FAILED' AND j.kind IN ('PARSE', 'PUBLISH') ), claimed_works AS (
SELECT pct.paper_id AS work_id, count(*)::bigint AS claim_count FROM paper_claim_table pct WHERE pct.paper_id IN (SELECT tp.matched_work_id FROM target_papers tp WHERE tp.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY pct.paper_id
SELECT work_id, claim_count FROM unnest( #{claims.workIds, typeHandler=com.paperflow.adapters.persistence.PgVarcharArrayTypeHandler}, #{claims.counts, typeHandler=com.paperflow.adapters.persistence.PgBigintArrayTypeHandler} ) AS cw(work_id, claim_count)
), latest_runs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.paper_id) r.paper_id, r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id IN (SELECT tp.paper_id FROM target_papers tp) ORDER BY r.paper_id, r.updated_at DESC ), papers AS ( SELECT v.source_id, v.publication_year AS year, (v.archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS archived, v.matched_work_id, v.updated_at, AS status, COALESCE(cw.claim_count, 0) AS claim_count, lr.status AS run_status FROM target_papers v LEFT JOIN failed_jobs fj ON fj.paper_id = v.paper_id AND fj.file_revision = v.file_revision LEFT JOIN claimed_works cw ON v.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND cw.work_id = v.matched_work_id LEFT JOIN latest_runs lr ON lr.paper_id = v.paper_id ), grouped AS ( SELECT FROM papers p GROUP BY p.source_id ) SELECT g.source_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(os.display_name), ''), g.source_id) AS name, g.total_papers, g.archived_papers, g.published_count, g.ready_count, g.unprocessed_count, g.failed_count, g.unsupported_count, g.matched_count, g.causal_extracted_count, g.causal_no_causal_count, g.causal_pending_review_count, g.causal_extracting_count, g.causal_failed_count, g.causal_not_extracted_count, g.causal_claim_count, g.year_min, g.year_max, g.latest_updated_at FROM grouped g LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = g.source_id
SELECT count(*) FROM work_source WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}

WITH target_papers AS ( SELECT v.paper_id, v.publication_year, v.matched_work_id, v.published_parse_id, v.latest_parse_id, v.file_revision, v.legacy_status, v.original_type FROM v2_paper v WHERE v.archived_at IS NULL AND v.source_id = #{sourceId} AND v.publication_year IS NOT NULL ), failed_jobs AS ( SELECT DISTINCT j.paper_id, j.file_revision FROM v2_job_item j JOIN target_papers tp ON tp.paper_id = j.paper_id AND tp.file_revision = j.file_revision WHERE j.state = 'FAILED' AND j.kind IN ('PARSE', 'PUBLISH') ), papers AS ( SELECT v.publication_year AS year, v.matched_work_id, AS status FROM target_papers v LEFT JOIN failed_jobs fj ON fj.paper_id = v.paper_id AND fj.file_revision = v.file_revision ) SELECT year, count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'READY') AS ready, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'UNPROCESSED') AS unprocessed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'UNSUPPORTED') AS unsupported, count(*) FILTER (WHERE matched_work_id IS NOT NULL) AS matched FROM papers GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC
